missing_evidence: Heap dump or allocation-site profile identifying the leaking object type in order service
Confirmation that retained growth continues toward the 160MB retention limit
candidates.statement: Order service shows sustained heap retention: retained_bytes rises 49.4MB to 81.4MB across 5 samples, net allocations exceed releases, and retained heap persists after GC (retained_after_gc true, 11 WARN retained_heap_after_gc logs). This is the only service with anomalous memory; gateway, payment, and inventory are flat.
candidates.uncertainty: Retained bytes remain below the 160MB limit and p95 latency is normal; leak is not yet shown to cause the checkout degradation.

report.explanation: Order is the only service with anomalous memory: retained heap grows monotonically and survives GC, with WARN retained_heap_after_gc logs. Other services are flat and error rates are low. Deployment record alone does not establish causation. Memory-leak is the single evidence-supported bounded candidate.
